review_scope: Read-only finite identity, alias, source-scope and relationship audit of immutable repository data. This artifact is candidate review evidence only and does not admit materials.

reproduction.input_acquisition: Read each listed repository path using git show <baseline_commit>:<path>; hash the resulting bytes with SHA-256. Do not substitute the current working tree.
reproduction.collections: Read all identities, grades and records from materials.json, all reference-property and source records, the three computed record collections, and all finite relationship and taxonomy/wood crosswalk inputs.
reproduction.labels: Collect nonblank strings from name, source_designation, designation, every names value and every aliases[].text. Occurrence counts include repeated multilingual names; they are not unique identities.
reproduction.comparison: Compare PNA-BPF-1 through PNA-BPF-5 with each label using strip/casefold, Unicode NFKC plus casefold and collapsed whitespace, and an additional ASCII alphanumeric-only comparison. Normalization is a conservative collision screen, not chemical equivalence.

text_screen.scope: Serialize complete identity, grade, state, source and computed records as JSON, preserving scope and evidence text; inspect contextual hits. Also inspect every polymer/composite identity and the finite relationship endpoints.

reproduction.existing_gate: scripts/prepare_formulation_packet.py::_labels and validate_identity_collisions inspect live source/state/property links and grade evidence. This audit did not invoke candidate-packet admission or replace that gate.
reproduction.structural_gate: materials_boundaries/material_references.py rejects exact structural identity/state clones. A clean textual screen alone is insufficient for admission.

relevant_precedents.identity_scope: Study-defined LPO-2 rigid polyurethane input formulation. The principal reactive Lupranol 3300/3422 input ratio is 66/34 g, distinct from the existing LPO-1 40/60 g ratio. This explicit input-formulation difference, not a label or catalyst/blowing-agent change alone, supports the selected identity. The study label is not a certified grade. No final cured-network molecular formula, elemental composition, purity or universal material equivalence is inferred.

Study-defined SPO-3 rigid polyurethane input formulation. The principal reactive SA-C_TOFA(50:50)/TMP and SA-E_ETOFA(50:50)/TMP input ratio is 40/60 g, distinct from the existing SPO-2 67/33 g ratio. The 50:50 values label precursor feeds, not the final 40/60 foam-polyol input ratio. This explicit input-formulation difference, not a label or catalyst/blowing-agent change alone, supports the selected identity. The study label is not a certified grade. No final cured-network molecular formula, elemental composition, purity or universal material equivalence is inferred.

Specific unfilled PBS/PBAT 70/30 blend from Bio PBS FZ 91 (PTT MCC BIOCHEM) and Eco flex C1200 (BASF). Source ratio basis is not explicitly stated: do not relabel 70/30 as wt/wt, mass fraction or volume fraction. Table 2 unfilled 100/0/0 formulation excludes added lignin and ZnO. Broad polymer category includes this polymer blend; constituent designations are not a finished-blend grade.

source_scope_comparison.application: Five different nominal principal reactive input recipes may support five source-qualified formulation identities if the separate source review confirms applicability. Final cured-network composition and global equivalence remain unresolved.
